Subject: Final acceptance criteria & e-sign window for pilot MAP

Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a light update to the MAP (Avery_MAP_v3.pdf) that pulls together the acceptance criteria we discussed and the evaluation checkpoints for the 30-day pilot. Two asks from our side to make the go/no-go smooth:

- Can Avery confirm the final success criteria by end of day Friday (items highlighted on page 2)? We used the scope from yesterday but flagged the two metrics (latency p90 and embedding similarity pass rate) that will determine acceptance.
- Who will be the signers on your side for commercial and SOW? If procurement/legal need a separate chain, please loop them in; we propose a 72-hour e-sign window so there’s no blocker for the planned start.

Proposed schedule:
- May 14: Final acceptance criteria confirmed by Avery
- May 16–17: Legal redline complete and e-sign window (DocuSign)
- May 24: Pilot start (data ingestion + smoke)
- June 24: Pilot end and acceptance evaluation

We attached the MAP draft and a short stub of roles for signature routing. If you want a brief call Thursday to lock the signers, happy to do 30 minutes.

Best,
Ben

Thanks, Ben —

Appreciate the clean summary. Quick notes from our side:

- The metrics on page 2 look right; Procurement wants the acceptance criteria codified in the SOW (no surprises). We should be explicit about the measurement windows (7-day rolling for latency, weekly embedding sample for quality).
- Legal (Tom) asked whether you can accept our redlines on clause 5 (data retention) — I copied him.
- For signers: Commercial will be me and our Head of Infra (Raj Patel). Procurement needs PO + e-sign. Can you hold a DocuSign window May 16–18? Procurement is out May 19–21.

If you can slip the start to May 26 instead of May 24, that gives us a buffer to get the PO processed. Otherwise we can try to keep May 24 if the DocuSign completes May 17.

On the call: I can do Thursday 11:00 PT to align on signers.

—Sarah
